This template provides a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) application set up to use Bootstrap styling that is deployed to AWS using the [CloudFront CDN](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/) and a [CloudFront Function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cloudfront-functions.html) for routing. [Lambda@Edge](https://aws.amazon.com/lambda/edge/) remains available as an alternative routing mechanism.
